scripts.escrow:versions: docker compose run --rm escrow-check sh -c "rustc --version && cargo --version && solana --version && anchor --version"
scripts.escrow:fmt: docker compose run --rm escrow-check cargo fmt --manifest-path programs/escrow/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.escrow:check: docker compose run --rm escrow-check cargo check --manifest-path programs/escrow/Cargo.toml
scripts.escrow:build: docker compose run --rm escrow-check anchor build
scripts.escrow:test: docker compose run --rm escrow-check bash scripts/run-escrow-test.sh
